summary: The response noted that federal and state air and noise regulations have become increasingly stringent, meaning earlier Interstate designs did not account for these factors to the same degree, and that the EIS document and public hearing process itself demonstrates planners' concern for area residents.
text:
Federal and State air and noise regulations have been continually changing and becoming more stringent over the last couple of years. The design of Interstate Highways prior to this time did not consider air and noise pollution to the same extent as today.
This document and the public hearing are evidence that highway planners are concerned with both the residents of this area as well as the taxpayer.
